procedural_exemplar_value: Tests a different class of generation grammar: subtractive nested caves, opposed diagonal geological load paths, roof-suspended entered facilities, three rooted deep-bore pockets, and upper/main/lower transfer proofs. Empty bays are explicit editable sockets rather than failure to furnish.
similarity_avoidance: Unlike the previously accepted single-clock Meridian Scar, continuous stormbeam Ion Parapet, two-horn Umbra Siphon, six-leg Pilgrim Gait, twin-dish Tin Canticle and four roof-island Ferric Pendulum, this corpus outlier is primarily an excavated geological interior with a diagonal double fault, three service pockets beneath the return route, and a split daylight access shaft; its strongest mass is actual rock rather than exposed machine architecture.
